name: Li Yüan-ying
bio: Li Yüan-ying (李元膺; Li Yuanying; 11th–12th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 洞仙歌 (Dong xian ge)
poems.author: Li Yüan-ying
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
雪云散尽，放晓晴池院。
杨柳于人便青眼。
更风流多处，一点梅心、相映远。
约略轻笑浅。
一年春好处，不在浓芳，小艳疏香最娇软。
到清明时候，百紫千红花正乱。
已失春风一半。
蚤占取韶光，共追游，但莫管春寒，醉红自暖。
